column1: # Tesla Model 3 and Model Y. These cars have no OBD-II answers at all; the
# values below are broadcast by the control units on the vehicle CAN bus
# (500 kbit) and Caruspex only listens. Needed is an adapter cable from the
# diagnostic connector of the car to an OBD-II socket (Model 3/Y: behind the
# rear centre console) and an ELM327 or STN adapter.
# The signal definitions come from the DBC file of the Model 3
# software may move or change single fields; a value that looks wrong then
# Battery health is not broadcast as such. The page computes it from the
# full pack energy today (Full kWh) against the energy when new (BOL kWh).
#@ title_de: Tesla Model 3 und Model Y (Mithören am CAN-Bus)
#@ title_en: Tesla Model 3 and Model Y (listening on the CAN bus)
